messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up — Trailblazer case story + launch post + webinar slot need final assets. Legal needs signoff by Friday EOD. We also want a short hero quote for social and 1–2 benchmark callouts for the webinar slide deck. Who can own quotes/metrics/transcript edits?
Gabi Rivera: I can shepherd the quotes and sync with customer tomorrow. Do we have an approved headshot and logo assets from their side? :thinking_face:
Leo Park: Trailblazer sent a headshot and brand kit earlier this week (see link). I'll pull the assets into the folder. Also drafted 3 hero quote options from the interview — posting below.
Leo Park: ```
1) "Redwood cut our inference costs while improving latency — shipped faster with fewer infra surprises."
2) "We saw a 35% reduction in per-request cost after moving to Redwood Dedicated."
3) "Redwood made the integration painless and predictable; our feature hit SLA targets from day one."
```
Jack O'Neill: I glanced at those. Option 2 is heavy on a number — need Trailblazer to confirm the 35% stat in writing, and legal wants a source/methodology blurb for the case study appendix.
Ana Morales: Confirming CS can provide the cost-comparison spreadsheet and the test harness details. Shane and I ran the benchmark under the "webapp-search" workload (median seq len 64, steady-state). Happy to export the results.
Shane Patel: Quick note — the 35% is for token-cost after enabling batching + KV cache. Raw model ops reduction was ~28%. Let's surface both in the appendix and use the conservative 35% language with a parenthetical method note.
Gabi Rivera: Good — I'll ask Trailblazer to approve quote #2 and sign off on the metric wording. ETA tomorrow afternoon.
Maya Chen: For the launch post copy, short headline + one para + CTA to webinar signup. Draft tweet thread for preview?
Leo Park: Draft tweet thread (feel free to shorten):
```
We partnered with Trailblazer to speed up product search and cut inference costs.
Result: 35% lower per-request cost and more consistent p99 latency.
Join our webinar 3/28 to see the benchmark and a live demo. Register: https://redwood.ai/events
```
DesignBot: Put the hero quote on a 16:9 social card — use Trailblazer primary brand color, keep logo left-aligned. Mockup in Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz
Jack O'Neill: One more legal point — any customer quote used in paid ads needs explicit written permission. Organic posts are ok with standard approval. Also request a short release: "Trailblazer consents to use of provided quotes and logos for marketing and partner promotion."
Ana Morales: I'll route the release to their legal contact this morning. They usually turn it around in 48 hours.
Shane Patel: For the webinar slide: can we include a single-slide benchmark summary (method, key metric, graph) + appendix slide with detailed numbers? That will satisfy sales & legal.
Maya Chen: Yes. Action items: Gabi to get written approval and release; Ana to deliver benchmark spreadsheet; Leo to finalize hero quote and draft post copy; Design to build social card and slide visuals; Jack to confirm legal wording. Target: internal review Wednesday, final signoff Friday.
Gabi Rivera: Putting it on my calendar — will ping Trailblazer after stand. :thumbsup:
Leo Park: FYI — customer asked to keep the live demo snippet under 2 minutes. Planning a small recorded clip of the 30s fast-path.
Maya Chen: Perfect. If all signs go green, we'll announce the blog + webinar + social the same day. Otherwise we'll gate social until release is fully cleared.
Jack O'Neill: Noted. I'll post any redlines directly to this thread so Gabi can triage.
Gabi Rivera: Thanks all — will update with approvals and the final one-line hero quote by 3pm PT tomorrow.
